falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A break of the August 2024 swing low equivalent would invalidate the 79% bottom pattern match, as that prior bottom held 4954; violating it confirms this is not a repeat bottom formation but rather a continuation of downtrend

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 35 for 2 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The August 2024 bottom featured VIX peaking at 38.57 but rapidly mean-reverting; sustained elevated fear above 35 indicates systemic stress absent in the prior pattern, proving this is a different regime (liquidation/bear market) not a tradable bottom

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y Treasury yield drops below 3.80% while SPX is simultaneously below 5200
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: This would signal a flight-to-safety bid in bonds alongside equity weakness, indicating recession pricing rather than the soft-landing/growth-scare dynamic of August 2024; the prior bottom saw yields rise with stocks (bear steepening), so this divergence invalidates the pattern match
